title: A transaction with minSeqLedgerGap fails at apply after a bump-to-0 in the same ledger
pattern: Core applies a ledger's classic phase before its Soroban phase and re-checks the source account, sequence number, signatures and sequence-age preconditions at apply (TransactionFrame::commonValid; OperationFrame::checkSignature with forApply). Here a classic transaction earlier in the same ledger runs BUMP_SEQUENCE with bumpTo 0 on the source: the sequence number does not change, but seqLedger moves to this ledger (BumpSequenceOpFrame.cpp maybeUpdateAccountOnLedgerSeqUpdate), so this transaction's minSeqLedgerGap of 1 is no longer met and it fails with txBAD_MIN_SEQ_AGE_OR_GAP.

hazards.placement: TransactionResult.txBAD_MIN_SEQ_AGE_OR_GAP in a closed ledger: seqLedger moved earlier in the ledger

facts.says: The transaction fails with tx_bad_min_seq_age_or_gap although it was valid when submitted.
The transaction that caused it is in the same ledger.
The sequence number is consumed: the source account changes before apply.
No operation was applied: the operation meta is empty.
The transaction source is the account changed earlier in the ledger.
The unused resource fee is refunded after apply (two changes on the fee source).
